summary: MaintServiceProfile is a web page and code-behind module for viewing and editing a service profile in the HSPnet system. It supports tabbed navigation for general details, position information, and historical records, and dynamically manages edit permissions based on user session and agency affiliation. The interface includes error and warning panels, printing and search capabilities, and validation logic for pay scale fields.
purpose: To enable authorized users (system administrators, staff admins, or agency members) to view and edit the profile of a service, including its general information, associated positions, and history, in a tabbed, interactive web environment.

workflows.name: Load and Display Service Profile
steps: On Page_Load, validate URL hash and retrieve ServiceID from query string.
Call LoadServiceInfo to populate profile and position existence, agency, and site usage.
Determine editability: set ReadOnly if ReadOnly query parameter is 1 or user/agency rules indicate non-editable.
On initial load (IsPostBack == false), select active tab based on CurrentPage query parameter.
Link child controls to set appropriate visibility and bind data for UCProfile, UCPositions, and UCHistory controls based on tab.
Setup header and existence flags (icons) for profile and positions based on existence.
Register client scripts and handle pre-render logic (resize window, process messages).
On tab change, re-link and re-bind relevant child controls.
On button clicks (search, print, close), execute corresponding handlers.

workflows.name: Validation of Pay Scales
steps: If either default or secondary pay scale is selected, effective date must be non-empty.
Secondary pay scale cannot be selected unless default pay scale is also selected.

workflows.name: Error and Warning Panel Handling
steps: Panels are toggled visible/invisible via client-side scripts.
Error and warning messages are processed and displayed in the panels.

business_rules: Screen is editable only if not ReadOnly and user is system administrator or belongs to the service agency.
Positions tab is enabled only if SiteUsesPositions is true.
Existence flags (icons) are shown for profile or positions if respective data exists.
Only system administrators and staff admins can edit position data.
validations: Pay scales: if a pay scale is selected, effective date is required.
Secondary pay scale cannot be selected unless default pay scale is also selected.
conditions: If ReadOnly query parameter equals 1, the screen is read-only.
If user is system administrator or matches service agency, screen can be editable.
Tab visibility and child control binding depend on which tab is currently active.
Existence icons depend on data presence.
system_behavior: Tabs switch between General, Positions, and History views.
Child controls (UCProfile, UCPositions, UCHistory) are dynamically bound and made visible or hidden based on tab selection and data availability.
Screen resizes to fixed size on pre-render.
Error and warning panels are client-side toggled.
Buttons handle printing, searching, and closing the window via client and server handlers.
exceptions: If ServiceID cannot be parsed, child controls may not bind or display data.
If profile or position does not exist, existence flag is not shown.
content_gaps: Details of ServiceProfile, ServicePositions, and ServiceProfileHistory user controls are referenced but their internal logic/content is not provided.
Some business logic and calculations may exist in referenced but not retrieved JavaScript and C# files.
Underlying data model and database schema are referenced but not detailed.
Exact error and warning message text is determined at runtime and not included.
